primary_task: Follow the repository's contribution guidelines to file an issue, create a branch, commit grouped changes and open a pull request.

requirements.name: git
requirements.evidence: allowed-tools: Bash(git:*); 'ensure a branch has been created', 'Commit the grouped code to the branch'

requirements.name: github-issue-pr-creation
requirements.evidence: allowed-tools: Bash(gh issue:*) Bash(gh pr:*); 'Before any issue is filed ... or pull request (or PR) created'
requirements.check: command -v gh; gh api -i user; gh issue list -L 1; gh pr list -L 1
requirements.observed: gh present; REST authenticated (scopes repo, workflow); gh issue/pr subcommands that use GraphQL return 403 'GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions'; github MCP connected (create_pull_request, issue_write, search_issues)

notes: gh CLI's GraphQL-backed `gh issue`/`gh pr` commands (list/create/checks) are refused by the session proxy; REST (`gh api repos/...`) works and the github MCP is connected, so issue/PR creation is achievable but not via the literal `gh issue`/`gh pr` subcommands. Target repo must also be attached to the session (user input). gh auth status falsely reports token invalid while API calls succeed.
